summary: Equinox Gold Corp. filed a Form 6-K on July 31, 2026, announcing the completion of its previously announced business combination with Orla Mining Ltd., creating North America's new senior gold producer. The combined company expects annual gold production of approximately 1.1 million ounces, with a path to over 1.9 million ounces. Ross Beaty stepped down as Chairman, becoming Chairman Emeritus; Chuck Jeannes was appointed incoming Chairman. No additional financial terms, premium, or advisors were disclosed in the excerpt. The transaction closed as planned, with leadership succession and board changes effective immediately. Watch for combined company operational guidance and potential synergies realization.
